tips.title: Auto-Selecting XP Potions is the the best way to Level Up
tips.text: It will automatically select the right XP Potions to level you up with as little waste as possible. Efficient and instant.
tips.screen: Loading screen hints (also listed in the FAQ)

tips.title: Elements Are Key
tips.text:
Invokers and all Enemies have an Element.

Elemental advantage means +30% more damage dealt, -30% damage taken, and more consistent debuffs. A weak Element matchup does the opposite.
tips.screen: Loading screen hints (also listed in the FAQ)

tips.title: Relics = Power
tips.text:
Relics provide huge Stat boosts to your Invokers - along with special effects if you equip multiple of the same Set.

Make sure each Invoker is fully equipped to maximize their power.
tips.screen: Loading screen hints (also listed in the FAQ)

tips.title: Relic Upgrades, Memorium, Gold
tips.text:
Upgrading Relics improves their Stats, making Invokers even stronger.

Sell or Crush unwanted Relics to get the Gold and Memorium you need to upgrade your best Relics.
tips.screen: Loading screen hints (also listed in the FAQ)

tips.title: Ascend To Higher Levels
tips.text:
Ascending your Invokers increases their level cap, which lets you keep levelling up.

Ascension also allows you to Awaken them - for even better stats and more power.
tips.screen: Loading screen hints (also listed in the FAQ)

tips.title: Don't Forget Daily Quests
tips.text: Completing your Daily Quests every day gives you lots of daily rewards and helps guide and maintain your early game progress.
tips.screen: Loading screen hints (also listed in the FAQ)

tips.title: Progress Fast With Progress Quests
tips.text: <color=#FFE606>Progress Quests</color> are specially designed to help streamline your progress as quickly and efficiently as possible - with huge rewards on offer
tips.screen: Loading screen hints (also listed in the FAQ)

tips.title: Debuffers Need Accuracy
tips.text:
You need more Accuracy than the enemy's Resistance to land debuffs consistently.

When applying a debuff, the caster's ACC Stat is pitted against the target's RES stat.
tips.screen: Loading screen hints (also listed in the FAQ)

tips.title: Buffs Don't Need Accuracy
tips.text: Unlike casting debuffs on enemies, casting buffs on your team doesn't require any Accuracy at all.
tips.screen: Loading screen hints (also listed in the FAQ)

tips.title: Relic Rarity
tips.text:
A Relic's Rarity decides how many Substats it has at Level 0.

When upgrading a Relic, at Levels 5, 10, 15, and 20, it will either unlock a new Substat, or upgrade an existing one - until it has a total of 4 Substats.
tips.screen: Loading screen hints (also listed in the FAQ)

tips.title: Star Power: Relic Rank
tips.text:
Indicated by the Stars on the Relic, a Relic's Rank dictates the values of the Main Stat and its Substats.

Stats on higher-Rank Relics will be higher than on lower-Rank Relics - even when upgraded.
tips.screen: Loading screen hints (also listed in the FAQ)

tips.title: Equip Full Relic Sets For Full Power
tips.text:
Every Relic brings Stat Boosts - but they also belong to a specific Set.

Equip 3 or 5 Relics from the same Set to get a Set Bonus - either an extra stat boost, or a powerful special effect.
tips.screen: Loading screen hints (also listed in the FAQ)

tips.title: Upgrading Skills Unlocks New Strength
tips.text: <color=#FFE606>Level Up Skills with Codexes</color> to increase their damage or unlock entirely new effects - making the Skill even stronger.
tips.screen: Loading screen hints (also listed in the FAQ)

tips.title: Codexes: Knowledge is Power
tips.text:
Upgrading Invoker's Skills makes them stronger and more effective - through increasing the damage, upgrading Buffs and Debuffs, or modifying a Skill's effects entirely.

Codexes are rare, but very powerful - use them wisely.
tips.screen: Loading screen hints (also listed in the FAQ)

tips.title: Titans Don't Have Elements
tips.text:
Titans don't have their own Element. When Invoked in battle, Titans behave like they have the same Element of the Invoker they are bound to.

This means each Titan can be used any time, anywhere.
tips.screen: Loading screen hints (also listed in the FAQ)

tips.title: Titans, Factions, Invokers
tips.text:
Invokers can only use Titans from their own Faction.

The only exception to this is Litria - a Guardian Titan. Litria is a special, universal Titan and can be used by any Invoker from any Faction.
tips.screen: Loading screen hints (also listed in the FAQ)

tips.title: Empower Titans For More... Power
tips.text:
Empowering Titans using Titanhearts increases their level cap and keep levelling them up.

It also increases the Stat Bonus that an Invoker receives during battle from having the Titan bound to them.
tips.screen: Loading screen hints (also listed in the FAQ)

tips.title: Titan Invokation
tips.text: Invoking a Titan lets an Invoker fight as a Titan for a short time – but that's not all.
tips.screen: Loading screen hints (also listed in the FAQ)

tips.title: Titan Prisms
tips.text:
Titan Prisms are used to upgrade Titan Skills, increasing damage, upgrading buffs and debuffs, or unlocking new effects.

Just like Codexes, you'll need all Rarities of Titan Prisms to upgrade a Titan's Skills.
tips.screen: Loading screen hints (also listed in the FAQ)

tips.title: Did You Know?
tips.text: <color=#FFE606>Combo Attacks have no cooldown.</color> They're always available to use.
tips.screen: Loading screen hints (also listed in the FAQ)

tips.title: Manage Your Active Skills
tips.text:
Active Skills have cooldowns. You need to wait a while after you use an Active Skill before you can use it again.

Using them or saving them for the right moment can make a huge difference.
tips.screen: Loading screen hints (also listed in the FAQ)

tips.title: Ultimate Mana for Ultimate Power
tips.text:
Using Combo Attacks and Skills during combat generates Ultimate Mana for that Invoker and unlocks their Ultimate Skill.

Pro Tip: Attacking while out of combat doesn't generate Mana.
tips.screen: Loading screen hints (also listed in the FAQ)

tips.title: Titan Mana
tips.text:
Combo Attacks and Skills generate Titan Mana, which is shared by the whole team. When a Titan is Invoked, Titan Mana is spent from the team's supply.

Attacking while out of combat doesn't generate Mana.
tips.screen: Loading screen hints (also listed in the FAQ)

tips.title: Need A Specific Relic? Hunt The Campaign
tips.text:
Each Campaign Chapter drops Relics from a specific Set. Each Level in a Chapter drops a certain kind of Relic – like Boots or Shields.

Hunting the Campaign is the fastest way to complete a Relic Set.
tips.screen: Loading screen hints (also listed in the FAQ)

tips.title: Tactics – The Front Line
tips.text:
Invokers in the Front Line of any Tactic will be targeted by more enemies than those in the Mid and Back Lines.

Ensure your Front Line Invokers have enough HP and DEF to survive. Tanks are a safe choice.
tips.screen: Loading screen hints (also listed in the FAQ)

tips.title: Relic Bosses & Best Relics
tips.text:
Fight Relic Bosses on Boss Mode to win the strongest Relics. The highest Rarity, highest Rank, and Sets that can't be found anywhere else.

Beat Relic Bosses on higher Stages to win the best Relics.
tips.screen: Loading screen hints (also listed in the FAQ)

tips.title: One Titan at a Time
tips.text:
You can only Invoke a single Titan at a time, so plan accordingly!

Timing your Invokation can be key to winning a battle, or even simply keeping an Invoker alive.
tips.screen: Loading screen hints (also listed in the FAQ)

tips.title: Invokation Time
tips.text:
Titan Invokation lasts 12 seconds - enough time to have serious impact on a battle.

But... Awakening Invokers can extend Invokation Time, making your Titans even more impactful.
tips.screen: Loading screen hints (also listed in the FAQ)

tips.title: XP Boosts
tips.text:
Activating an XP Boost increases the number and value of XP Potions you win from battles.

50% More XP means 50% faster levelling and 50% faster progress. Don't sleep on it.
tips.screen: Loading screen hints (also listed in the FAQ)

tips.title: The Spires Don't Cost Energy
tips.text:
The Spires give huge daily rewards for zero Energy.

You get 30 free Spire Keys every day – 5 per Element.

And you don't lose a Key unless you win a Battle – so you can keep trying until you win.
tips.screen: Loading screen hints (also listed in the FAQ)

tips.title: Tags
tips.text:
Invoker Tags, shown in your Collection and when summoning a new Invoker, indicate what type of skills an Invoker has.

Check out an Invoker's Tags to quickly see what they're all about at a glance.
tips.screen: Loading screen hints (also listed in the FAQ)

tips.title: Invoker Classes
tips.text:
In Invoker's Class decides which Crests they need for Awakening and how their Base Stats are distributed.

There are four Classes – Support, Tank, Ranged Attacker, Melee Attacker.
tips.screen: Loading screen hints (also listed in the FAQ)

tips.title: Invoker Tolerances & Boss Corruptions
tips.text:
Each Boss has two different Corruptions - one Damage Corruption and one Control Corruption.

Each Invoker has one or two Tolerances that directly mitigate the effects of these Corruptions.
tips.screen: Loading screen hints (also listed in the FAQ)

tips.title: Need Essences? Beat the Garuda
tips.text:
Beating the Elemental Garuda on Boss Mode is the main way to get the Essences you need to Awaken your Invokers.

There are 7 different Elements of the Garuda – each dropping a different type of Essence.
tips.screen: Loading screen hints (also listed in the FAQ)

tips.title: Did You Know? You Can Play Invokers Offline
tips.text:
Even if you don't have internet access, you can keep playing Invokers while offline and keep making progress.

Never be bored on a flight, or at the bottom of the ocean ever again.
tips.screen: Loading screen hints (also listed in the FAQ)

tips.title: Invoker Rarity AoE Limits
tips.text:
There is a limit to how many enemies each Invoker can attack with their AoE skills, according to their Rarity.

Common, Uncommon: 7 enemies. Rare: 8 enemies. Epic: 9 enemies. Legendary: 10 enemies.
tips.screen: Loading screen hints (also listed in the FAQ)

tips.title: Boss Control Corruptions
tips.text:
Control Corruptions limit what your team can do, such as stunning or freezing them, or blocking or disabling their skills.

Corruptions usually have more dangerous effects than normal Debuffs.
tips.screen: Loading screen hints (also listed in the FAQ)

tips.title: Tolerances by Rarity
tips.text:
Tolerances directly mitigate the effects of Boss Corruptions.

Common, Uncommon, and Rare Invokers each have one Tolerance.

Epic and Legendary Invokers have two Tolerances.
tips.screen: Loading screen hints (also listed in the FAQ)

tips.title: Boss Damage Corruptions
tips.text: Damage Corruptions are a secondary source of damage that the Boss outputs - usually Damage-Over-Time - along with extra effects that hinder your team. Damage Corruptions have infinite duration.
tips.screen: Loading screen hints (also listed in the FAQ)

tips.title: Increasing Tolerance
tips.text:
You can also gain or increase Tolerances with certain Relic Sets.

Equip Relics and use Invokers with the right Tolerances to give yourself an easier time against the Bosses.
tips.screen: Loading screen hints (also listed in the FAQ)

1. Be respectful
We're all here to have fun, so treat all players with respect. Friendly debates and constructive discussions are encouraged, but personal attacks, insults, or discrimination will not be tolerated.

2. Keep it light, keep it clean, keep it focused
The chat is a place for everyone to discuss Invokers, so refrain from using profanity, explicit, or otherwise inappropriate language, or derailing conversations to discuss unrelated topics. Our automated system will automatically censor certain words and phrases, but we reserve the right to delete or block messages that are not appropriate. Sharing violent, sexually explicit, politically inflammatory, or abusive content is strictly prohibitied.

3. No spamming
Spamming a channel with repeated messages, posting the same message across multiple channels, repeating posting copy-paste text, or excessive symbols makes it harder for everyone to communicate. Spam messages will be deleted and players may be muted or banned for repeated violations.

4. No advertising
Promoting or advertising unrelated third-party products, services, other games, or websites is forbidden, along with posting links to said services. This includes account buying, selling, or trading services.

5. No sharing of in-game exploits, cheats, or leaked material
Discussion and/or sharing of cheats or in-game exploits that give an unfair advantage to other players is strictly prohibited, alongside the sharing of unreleased content accessed via illegal means. If you have encountered issues or bugs in-game, please report them via Support.

6. Use the correct language channels
Each chat channel is organized by language, so please communicate in the relevant channel language.

7. Follow moderator instructions
Chat moderators are here to keep chat safe and fun for all. When a moderator tells you to stop, stop. Ignoring or arguing with moderator actions may lead to longer mutes or chat bans.

Violations of the above rules may result in a temporary mute or further, more decisive action, depending on the severity or number of the offense. Moderators have the final word for resolving issues in chat.

Remember - chat is shared by multiple players and is a place for everyone to discuss Invokers. Help keep it fun and friendly for everyone!

Clearing Floors in the Spires is one of the best ways to earn rewards and make fast progress every month. Invokers of a corresponding Element can enter each Spire.

By clearing Floors in each Spire, you’ll get your hands on a bunch of valuable rewards, such as Gold, Memorium, Stars, Orbs, Titanhearts, Echoes, and Codexes.
There are 6 Spires - one for each Element - and you get 5 Spire Keys each day, per Spire.

You won’t lose a Spire Key if you fail to clear a Floor - you’ll only use up a Key when you win, so you can keep trying and tweaking your approach without any worry.

The Spires reset every month, so make sure to use your Keys every day to maximize your rewards and grab all the loot you can. Don’t miss out.

<color=#F8D962>Light</color> and <color=#8B5CF6>Dark</color> function differently in PvP – while still strong vs. the other 4 Elements, they also counter each other!
